text:
nina park: Quick vendor sync notes from today's call — H100 microcode 5.2 slipped ~2w, MI300 driver 4.0 still green, Gaudi infra requested a separate onprem signed-track for SIs. They want a single embargo/playbook so marketplace flips and press don't collide.
omar diaz: We should avoid flipping marketplace tags and external press on same day. Propose marketplace tag publish T-72h before press. APAC needs extra firmware cert time (+4 business days).
lucy cho: For SIs we'll supply two image channels: `h100-preview` and `mi300-signed`. Provide sha256 + signed manifest and short verification steps. I'll own the image manifests.
ben thomas: Ops: can carve a small staging cluster (H100/MI300/Gaudi mix). Suggest numbers: 30 H100, 20 MI300, 15 Gaudi nodes for dryruns. Need partner CIDRs for temporary ACLs.
eva muller: Legal-EU asked for a 72h docs review on partner-facing material. Please tag `legal-eu` on the PRs and include a short risk checklist.
nina park: Draft rollout plan below (open to edits):
```
- Day -14: publish compatibility matrix + signed image process to partners
- Day -10: SI invites and staging ACLs configured
- Day -7: SI dryruns (phased by region NA->EU->APAC)
- Day -3: publish marketplace SKUs (internal embargo)
- Day 0: press announce (48-72h embargo had been given)
- Day +3: monitor canaries and escalate if thermal/kernel regressions > threshold
```
omar diaz: Add a runtime fallback policy: if thermal events >8% over 15m, route to MI300 or Gaudi-compatible variants. Simple config example: `fallback_threshold_pct=8, fallbacks=[mi300-compat, gaudi-lt]`.
lucy cho: SKU naming proposal: `H100-5.2-market`, `H100-5.2-dedicated`, `MI300-4.0-market`, `MI300-4.0-signed`. I'll drop the mapping in the SKU sheet tonight: https://docs.internal/redwood/partner-sku-registry (internal).
ben thomas: I'll open infra ticket to reserve staging racks and list CIDRs. Also will add a canary dashboard with 1m/5m panels for thermal, kernel oops, and RPC latency.
eva muller: I'll block a legal review slot on Day -5 and add the required checklist to the PR template.
nina park: Runbook ask from partner PMs: 1-pager for SI troubleshooting (image verify, kernel logs, docker runtime flags). Can someone volunteer?
lucy cho: I'll draft the runbook 1-pager and include `dmesg` filters and `curl` health checks, e.g.: `curl -sS https://staging.redwood/api/v1/image/verify | jq .`
omar diaz: Also include rollback steps: revoke marketplace tag, restore previous SKU alias, and revoke partner ACLs if needed.
partners-bot: Calendar event created: "Cross-vendor staging + SI dryrun" on 2026-07-14 09:00 UTC. Invitees: partnerships, eng-runtime, ops, legal-eu
ben thomas: Action items: @lucy publish manifests + SKU mapping, @ben reserve racks + dashboards, @eva schedule legal review, @omar write fallback policy PR. Please update by EOD Wed.
nina park: If there are no objections we'll share this timeline with vendor PMs tomorrow morning. :rocket:
lucy cho: +1
ben thomas: +1
eva muller: +1
partners-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping channel 5 days before Day -14 start.
